Lina (CS): Heads-up: renewal-risk signal showing for 4 recent trials — usage plateau after day 7 and no enablement session booked.
Tom (CS Ops): Do we have a concrete metric? what threshold triggered this?
Lina (CS): Metric = ww_usage_pct_change < 5% between day 7 and day 14 AND no calendar event with `enablement_session` tag.
Nisha (Platform): We can emit a CRM tag `needs_enablement` + create a follow-up task for CSMs. Prefer write-only service principal to avoid permission escalations.
Elliot (SRE): If the playbook auto-schedules invites, calendar quota & impersonation policies matter. We should limit to 10 auto-invites per minute and include opt-out.
Tom (CS Ops): Also want to capture enablement_feedback=false if they never attend after 3 reminders -> bump renewal_risk to `medium` and create a renewal outreach sequence.
Lina (CS): For context include top 2 engagement signals (most_active_feature, avg_session_minutes) and recent NPS comment snippet if present. That helps CSMs prep.
Nisha (Platform): Proposed playbook flow: 1) webhook from telemetry when week14_plateau AND no_event -> 2) upsert CRM: needs_enablement=true, add note with signals -> 3) trigger playbook `cs/enablement/auto_schedule_v1` to propose 3 timeslots via email/calendar & create CSM task if user declines.
playbook-bot: New playbook template created: `cs/enablement/auto_schedule_v1` (id: pb_2026_05). Triggers: webhook.week14_plateau == true AND crm.needs_enablement == true.
Elliot (SRE): sample webhook payload (dev hook):
```
{
  "account_id": "acct_77722",
  "ww_usage_pct_change": 3.2,
  "most_active_feature": "vector-search",
  "avg_session_minutes": 8.4,
  "nps_snippet": "docs unclear around onboarding",
  "has_enablement_event": false
}
```
Tom (CS Ops): Dedupe rule: only set `needs_enablement` once per 30 days unless CSM clears it. Playbook can still send daily reminders for 3 days.
Nisha (Platform): We'll surface an `auto_invite_status` in CRM notes: proposed/pending/accepted/declined. Service account will add invites as `proposed` using calendar API and include 3 selectable time slots.
Lina (CS): Acceptance criteria: telemetry emits event, CRM field set without overwriting manual flags, playbook creates calendar proposals, CSM task created on decline, audit log entries present.
Tom (CS Ops): Action items: Lina - confirm acceptance criteria & sample NPS mapping (by EOD). Nisha - spike calendar integration in dev sandbox (3d). Elliot - validate rate limits and service account scope (today). I'll create the Ops ticket and link it here. :white_check_mark:
Lina (CS): Thanks. I'll draft the CSM email templates and a short script for the call prep notes.
